title: JAPAN — JP-02 — Takaichi Political-Funding Network
description: A public-record OSINT case study of political donations, support organisations, business/public-sector intersections, vendor relationships, and evidentiary limits in Japan. The release contains full English and Japanese public editions plus the publication/privacy review. It distinguishes verified facts, corroborated information, reported information, analytical judgments, hypotheses, negative findings, and unresolved questions. It does not determine criminal, civil, electoral, tax, regulatory, or ethical liability.
